Exchanging our own petty footnotes on the dead letters of ancient greats, through those luminaries of Truth we have come to slip from the light of Truth that shines ever anew as a perpetually contemporary, though noble, spirit and energy. We trade, back and forth, doctorings and hackneyed interpretations which we further degrade as we use them for the leverage of our arcane intents. But what else do you expect from a culture in flight from its own sullen ghost, seeking foreign exports to get a taste for its own homely Being? We dare not drink the bitter libation of our moment, and thus we miss dearly the unique spirit of the times, the portal, as in all times, to the timeless.
